open_errors.issue: The bible says Devan never lies to Neela. In ch 5 he tells Neela and Kannan 'I have to see Bhaskaran about the gate', and the narration says 'It was not true.'
open_errors.fix: In ch 5, change his line to a true one, such as 'I need a moment,' and cut 'It was not true.' The walk to the cistern wall can stay as it is.

open_errors.issue: Neela asks why Raiu was moved and Devan answers 'Oil.' The narration has already said 'It did not save oil.' That is a direct lie to Neela, which breaks his fixed voice rule. Ch 17 and ch 30 also rely on him never having lied to her.
open_errors.fix: In ch 8, replace Devan's answer 'Oil.' with 'I won't answer that.' Keep her next line, 'Then I'll be sparing with mine,' as it is.

open_errors.issue: Chinna is a woman (ch 1 'a broad woman', ch 18, ch 21 'Chinna's got a bad hip', ch 31 'her bad hip'). In ch 13 Neela says 'Tell Chinna it's for the warden. He'll hurry.'
open_errors.fix: In ch 13, change 'He'll hurry.' to 'She'll hurry.'

open_errors.issue: In the supper scene, ch 14 reads 'Chinna at the kitchen door with his bad hip.' Chinna is a woman.
open_errors.fix: In ch 14, change 'his bad hip' to 'her bad hip'.

open_errors.issue: Devan says that on the wedding night she 'slipped the latch like somebody who had done it before, carefully, so the slat wouldn't ring.' In ch 1 Neela leaned on the third slat on purpose to make it creak, and in ch 2 Devan's POV records that 'The third slat creaked.'
open_errors.fix: In ch 17, change the line to: 'Then it slipped the latch like somebody who had done it before, and leaned on the third slat to see if the creak would wake me.'

open_errors.issue: Ch 20 calls Neela's lie that Devan 'thinks I'm a bride who sleeps badly' 'a first lie'. In ch 18 she had already lied to Ammu several times ('Nobody's seen', 'To learn his sleep', 'He sleeps like a log'), and ch 18 records that as her first lie told to protect someone else.
open_errors.fix: In ch 20, change 'So it was a first lie' to 'So it was the first lie of the morning'.

open_errors.issue: In ch 17 Neela gives her only knife, the plain six-inch guild knife, to Devan and lays it on his side of the sword (F399). In ch 24 Devan thinks of her asleep 'with her knife under the mattress'. In ch 25 she runs down the stair with 'the plain guild knife in her hand', and in ch 26 it is in her belt. No scene shows the knife going back to her.
open_errors.fix: In ch 24's rampart scene, after 'I'll double the watch,' add a short beat where Devan takes the guild knife from his belt and holds it out to her hilt first ('Vellan's coming. It's yours.'). Change his POV line to 'with the knife he had given back to her under the mattress.'

open_errors.issue: Ch 7 says Unni is 'not much past twenty'. In ch 12, Asha's slate lists Unni among the recruits she wrote down in her first month at the fort, which was about nine years ago (she arrived at 19 and died at 22, six years ago). That would make him a recruit at about eleven.
open_errors.fix: In ch 7, change 'not much past twenty' to 'five-and-twenty and still blushing like a boy'.

open_errors.issue: Ch 11 has Neela recall that Janu said 'He used to have a partner' 'in the first week, over the supper pots.' In ch 3 Janu said it at the lip of the kalari pit during the tour.
open_errors.fix: In ch 11, change 'over the supper pots' to 'at the lip of this pit'.

open_errors.issue: Ch 16 says Neela 'had missed it twice already, the fever night and the night of the narrows', meaning the cup at the meeting stone. In ch 14 she dragged a late scent-mark across the cup on her way back from the narrows. In ch 18 Ammu counts bare cups without the narrows night ('Three nights... Four, if I count the night of the fever').
open_errors.fix: In ch 16, change the clause to: 'She had missed it outright on the fever night, and marked it only late and cold on the night of the narrows.'
